## Exam 2 information {#sec-Exam2info}

-   Exam 2 will be on Wed, Nov. 5th
-   Samples of [past exam questions](https://sakai.ohsu.edu/access/content/group/BSTA-511-1-AA-F25/Exam_samples/Exam_2_samples_Ch3.1-3.4_4.1-4.2.pdf) and [answers](https://sakai.ohsu.edu/access/content/group/BSTA-511-1-AA-F25/Exam_samples/Exam_2_samples_Ch3.1-3.4_4.1-4.2_answers.pdf) (on Sakai)
-   Material will cover **Days 6-9**,
    -   which is approximately **Sections 3.1-3.4, 4.1-4.2** from the textbook.
-   The exam will be in-class and handwritten. *Bring a calculator.*
-   You may bring one page of notes on an 8.5” x 11” sheet of paper.
    -   You may use both sides.
    -   You may type your notes.
    -   You may **not** use screenshots of the notes or textbook
    -   You will be turning in the page of notes with the exam, so please add your name to the sheet.
